force.title: Commodity Whiplash
force.signature: Mining, drilling, and growing move on violent price cycles set by geopolitics and weather — the extraction economy the country forgot it still runs on.

A \u00b7 Digging it up: Metal miners live and die by global prices and the electrification demand wave.
Aggregates track construction demand and energy costs.
Coal rides a structural decline punctuated by data-center power spikes.
B \u00b7 Drilling & refining: Drillers and refiners swing on crude prices and policy whiplash.
Fuel and petrochemical makers pass through — or eat — volatile input costs.
C \u00b7 Growing it: Farmers and processors are whipsawed by commodity prices, tariffs, and weather.
Fertilizer and grain trading concentrate the commodity risk of the whole food chain.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: the extraction economy runs on violent price cycles; hedgers and consolidators survive, small single-commodity players don't.
